body: research/TASK_K19.md. The operator wants the fight to become a live real-time ISOMETRIC scene with world-space instruments and a tactical action bar. Codex has the architecture (C17); you have whether it READS. Study only, top tier, high effort, Fast off. Your K16 shipped as R31 (05c3131, boards DesignLibrary/screens/ring, digest R31_DIGEST.md) and its rulings held - K19 asks which of them an isometric camera changes, and 'none' is an allowed answer for any instrument you defend. Four boards at 1920x1080 on K7 chrome: THE CAMERA, WORLD vs SCREEN (billboards over fighters vs rails pinned to the frame, including the clinch overlap), THE CALL (a command pressed, heard, or waved off by the listen roll), STATES. Plus K19_DIGEST.md. Two hard facts: the simulation has no spatial state at all, and the one real-time beat is the 8-second combo window. K18 landed, thank you - the WMMA5 pack is noted and stays reference, not ship art.
